REPORT zreg_fs_row.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_package,
         name TYPE string,
         size TYPE i,
       END OF ty_package.
DATA gt_packages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_package WITH DEFAULT KEY.
DATA gs_package TYPE ty_package.
FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_package> LIKE LINE OF gt_packages.
FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_found> TYPE LINE OF gt_packages.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  gs_package-name = 'ZCORE'.
  gs_package-size = 1.
  APPEND gs_package TO gt_packages.
  LOOP AT gt_packages ASSIGNING <ls_package>.
    WRITE / <ls_package>-name.
  ENDLOOP.
  READ TABLE gt_packages ASSIGNING <ls_found> INDEX 1.
  WRITE / <ls_found>-name.
